Choose one default test approach for a new documentation skill:

1. A structural Bash test. It runs quickly, but it does not test agent behavior.
2. Fresh-context prompt tests. They test agent behavior, but use more model time.
3. A structural Bash test plus a small set of prompt tests. This checks files and behavior, but uses some model time.

All options are local and unshared. You can change the choice before merge. There is no existing test convention. Decide and record why.
